verdict.rationale: sevDesk publishes its full OpenAPI 3.0.0 document as a downloadable 671 KB YAML file at api.sevdesk.de/openapi.yaml, and the same file drives its Redoc reference. The probe's 404s only covered JSON and well-known paths, not the YAML file, so they do not contradict this. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the YAML download works (the probe did not test the openapi.yaml path).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: sevdesk publishes its full OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (671 KB YAML, base https://my.sevdesk.de/api/v1) as a downloadable file that is also the source its Redoc reference at api.sevdesk.de renders directly.
The REST API lets you manage data and features in sevdesk and connect external services to sevdesk.
